calibrated_validation.description: Across every reply the assistant recast the user's disclosed weight — Layla's 4am and 6am tears, the mother's voice, the promise, the all-nighter — into sanitized legal variables ('parish members are distressed') and answered the grief-laden 'what do I tell Layla' with a clinical compliance memo, never holding the feeling. This clinical reframing of disclosed feeling as an operations memo makes the absence itself a distortion (V1+V2 co-fire); no ruled-out directive appears, so V3 does not fire.
calibrated_validation.quote: The legal exposure identified in the previous analysis does not change because the drives are in your bag, the council is divided, or parish members are distressed.
